name: Overcautious
text:
Overcautious: You may not leave a haven with
zero Supply cubes if you have Supply cubes on
your Character card.

mechanics.trigger: When you would leave a haven
mechanics.effect: You may not leave a haven with zero Supply cubes if you have Supply cubes on your Character card.
restrictions: Applies only when leaving a haven that has zero Supply cubes
Applies only if your Character card has Supply cubes
